title: Programs started at login
whyItMatters: These entries show what runs by itself every time the user logs in: sync clients, chat apps, remote access tools. The names are a short list of what the person relies on.
source: freedesktop.org Autostart spec: per-user autostart entries are .desktop files in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/autostart: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/autostart-spec/latest/
notes: Names only. System-wide entries live in /etc/xdg/autostart and are not counted here; a user entry with the same file name overrides a system one.
